findings.current: bringing his great saber down with all his strength
findings.defect: The source says Mu Song brought the saber down forcefully here; it reserves “with all his strength” for the later moment when he twists the saber. The current wording adds maximal exertion to the first action.
findings.rationale: The source uses 힘차게 for the downward slash and 온 힘을 다해 for the later twist. Keeping those distinct preserves the difference in intensity.
findings.replacement: bringing his great saber down in a forceful slash

summary: The assembled chapter is faithful overall. One minor intensity shift adds a degree of exertion not stated at that moment in the source.
